notes: Cloud Master authority release. Retires the obsolete whole-dataset polling/conflict engine that could recreate Product Master, Product Inventory, Customer Orders, Special Orders and Cutting History conflicts after record-level Cloud Master was already active. Sync Now and background refresh now route only through the record-level Supabase Cloud Master path. Stale legacy conflict metadata and its Settings UI are cleared without modifying business records; genuine record-level Cloud Master queue items, conflicts and errors remain protected and visible.
